definitions.short: Noadjah , the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess
definitions.full: H5129. Noadyah נוֺעַדְיָה proper name ( meeting with Yah ) — 1. masculine Levite, contemporary of Ezra Ezra 8:33 . 2. feminine a prophetess hostile to Nehemiah Neh 6:14 .

occurrences.englishText: On the fourth day the silver and the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth the son of Uriah the priest; and with him was Eleazar the son of Phinehas; and with them was Jozabad the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah the son of Binnui, the Levite;
“Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.”
